parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
ashore[aJ6:r]adv.
If something goes ashore, it goes from water to the land.
→ After a long day of fishing, Glen pulled his boat ashore, so it wouldn’t float away.
😎
contradict[kantradikt]v.
To contradict means to state the opposite of what someone else has.
→ Ken was always fighting with his little sister because she kept contradicting him.
😎
counterpart[kauntarpdirt]n.
A counterpart is something that is very similar to something else in what it does.
→ Our manager will meet our rival company’s counterpart later today.
😎
devoid[divoid]adj.
When something or someone is devoid of a thing, they are missing it.
→ The movie was devoid of any violence, so it was a perfect movie for the family.
😎
diverge[diva:rd3]v.
To diverge is to become different or to follow a different direction.
→ The road diverged into two paths that led to our houses.
😎
elude[iiu:d]v.
To elude means to avoid being caught by something.
→ The rabbit eluded the wolf by hiding in a bush.
😎
embryo[embridu]n.
An embryo is a human or animal that is still growing inside its mother.
→ Some doctors say that what a mother eats has a big effect on her embryo.
😎
fend[fend]v.
To fend off something means to push it away and avoid it.
→ Dave spent all night fending off bugs instead of sleeping.
😎
fictitious[fiktifas]adj.
When something is fictitious, it is made up and not real.
→ The author said that the characters in her book were completely fictitious.
😎
gazette[gazet]n.
A gazette is a newspaper.
→ Alice wants to write for a gazette when she’s older.
😎
homogeneous[houmad3i:nias]adj.
If something is homogeneous, it is made up of things which are all the same.
→ All of the houses on Victor’s block were boring and homogenous.
😎
obstruct[abstrAkt]v.
To obstruct something means to get in its way.
→ The car broke down on the road and obstructed traffic for hours.
😎
plunge[plAnd3]v.
To plunge means to move down into something very quickly.
→ The water in the pool was very cold, but the boy plunged in anyway.
😎
prolong[proul5:r|]v.
To prolong means to make something last for a longer time.
→ Sandy walked slowly across the beach, trying to prolong her lunch break.
😎
publicize[pAblasaiz]v.
To publicize is to make something get a lot of attention.
→ The company publicized the job positions in the newspaper.
😎
sparse[spa:rs]adj.
If something is sparse, there is not very much of it in a big area.
→ Rob spent Saturday in his garden, clearing out the sparse weeds.
😎
surplus[sexplAs]n.
A surplus is an extra amount of something.
→ The store sold their surplus items on sale.
😎
theorize[ei:araiz]v.
To theorize means to develop ideas about something.
→ They enjoyed theorizing about how things worked.
😎
verify[verafai]v.
To verify means to find out if something is true.
→ Julian called the movie theater to verify that the movie started at nine.
😎
vigorous[vigaras]adj.
If something or someone is vigorous, they use a lot of energy.
→ Henry uses vigorous exercise to keep himself in shape.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: What animal can survive ashore?
questions.explanation: An alligator can survive ashore.

questions.content: How can someone devoid of any happiness be described?
questions.explanation: Devoid of happiness means lacking happiness, so depressed.

questions.content: How do turtles elude predators?
options: They dig a hole in the ground
questions.explanation: They hide in their shells to elude predators.

questions.content: What is something that people can plunge into?
questions.explanation: People can plunge into a pool.

questions.content: Which of the following is NOT used to obstruct sunlight?
questions.explanation: A telescope is not used to obstruct sunlight.

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: I obstructed my brother from coming in by locking the door.
questions.explanation: obstruct means to get in its way.

questions.content: I ate a light snack to fend off my hunger.
questions.explanation: fend off means to push away and avoid.

questions.content: The river diverged into three different channels.
questions.explanation: diverge means to follow a different direction.

questions.content: Sheila publicized her party over the Internet. She didn’t want a lot of people to know about it.
questions.explanation: publicize means to make something get a lot of attention, contradicting 'didn't want a lot of people to know'.

questions.content: I viewed this morning’s gazette to find out about today’s weather.
questions.explanation: gazette is a newspaper.

questions.content: Jason always contradicted what his friend said. They agreed about everything.
questions.explanation: contradict means to state the opposite, contradicting 'agreed about everything'.

questions.content: Andrew verified that his friends were coming to his house, so his mom could make enough food for dinner.
questions.explanation: verify means to find out if something is true.

questions.content: Did you remember to take the hot pan off of the counterpart?
questions.explanation: counterpart means something very similar to something else in what it does, not a physical object like a counter.

questions.content: Class was prolonged because Shelly had a lot of questions. By the time she was done, school had been over for ten minutes.
questions.explanation: prolong means to make something last for a longer time.

questions.content: Greg didn’t like vigorous exercise, so he played many different sports.
questions.explanation: vigorous means using a lot of energy, and playing sports is usually vigorous exercise.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Amazing Komodo Dragons

Once, a British gazette had an unusual story. Scientists at a zoo made a discovery about komodo dragons. Komodo dragons are giant lizards that grow up to two and a half meters long. A female lizard at the zoo had babies. However, it had never been around a male lizard in its entire life. After the scientists publicized their discovery, many people thought it was fictitious.

But it was true. It was discovered that female komodo dragons can have babies without the help of their male counterparts. This contradicts what scientists know about how most animals have babies.

In most cases, there are many things that can obstruct this type of reproduction. For example, adult males and females carry different genes needed to make an embryo. If the genes are homogeneous, the babies are weaker and have genetic problems. Over time, the weakened species dies out completely. This makes it necessary for the male to be involved. However, scientists verified that when Komodo babies are born, their genes aren’t the exact same genes as their mother. Also, they are devoid of any genetic problems.

Scientists theorize that Komodo dragons developed the ability because it helps the species fend off extinction. If a volcano erupts, lava can kill all of the komodo dragons on an island. However, as long as one female eludes death, she can prolong the survival of the species. Luckily, Komodo dragons are vigorous swimmers. So the surviving female can plunge into the ocean and swim to another island. When she comes ashore, she can reproduce by herself. Over time, the genes within the population diverge. Then, the sparse population increases. Once again there is a surplus of lizards on one island. Scientists think that this may be how the lizards took over all of the islands in that area.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: People thought that the story publicized in the gazette about the komodo dragons was fictitious.
questions.explanation: Câu này là True (Đúng) . Trong đoạn 1 có viết: 'After the scientists publicized their discovery, many people thought it was fictitious.' (Sau khi các nhà khoa học công bố khám phá của họ, nhiều người cho rằng đó là chuyện hư cấu). Ý của câu hỏi miêu tả chính xác sự việc này!

questions.content: Female komodo dragons can have babies without their male counterparts.
questions.explanation: Câu này là True (Đúng) nhé. Ở đoạn 2 có câu: 'It was discovered that female komodo dragons can have babies without the help of their male counterparts.' (Người ta phát hiện ra rằng những con rồng komodo cái có thể sinh con mà không cần sự giúp đỡ của những con đực). Câu này hoàn toàn trùng khớp !

questions.content: Scientists verified that baby komodo dragons have homogeneous genes if they don’t have fathers, which leads to genetic problems.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Đoạn 3 khẳng định ngược lại: '...scientists verified that when Komodo babies are born, their genes aren’t the exact same genes as their mother. Also, they are devoid of any genetic problems.' (...các nhà khoa học đã xác minh rằng khi những con Komodo con được sinh ra... chúng không mắc phải bất kỳ vấn đề di truyền nào). Tức là chúng KHÔNG hề có hệ gen đồng nhất hay gặp vấn đề di truyền nhé!

questions.content: Scientists theorize that the special ability of komodo dragons help them elude predators.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Đoạn 4 có viết: 'Scientists theorize that Komodo dragons developed the ability because it helps the species fend off extinction.' (Các nhà khoa học đưa ra giả thuyết rằng rồng Komodo phát triển khả năng này vì nó giúp loài này chống lại sự tuyệt chủng). Khả năng này dùng để chống lại sự tuyệt chủng chứ không phải để lẩn tránh động vật ăn thịt (predators) đâu nhé!

questions.content: A female komodo dragon can increase a sparse population so that there are surplus lizards on one island.
questions.explanation: Câu này là True (Đúng) nhé. Theo đoạn 4: 'Then, the sparse population increases. Once again there is a surplus of lizards on one island.' (Sau đó, quần thể thưa thớt tăng lên. Một lần nữa lại có số lượng lớn thằn lằn dư thừa trên một hòn đảo). Nội dung câu hỏi đã tóm tắt chính xác diễn biến này!

questions.content: How do komodo dragons contradict what scientists know about reproduction?
options: They can reproduce without a father.
They lay eggs in the water.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Ở đoạn 2 có giải thích: '...female komodo dragons can have babies without the help of their male counterparts. This contradicts what scientists know...' (...rồng komodo cái có thể sinh con mà không cần sự giúp đỡ của con đực. Điều này mâu thuẫn với những gì các nhà khoa học biết...). Do đó chọn A là chuẩn nhất !

questions.content: Why is it possible for a komodo dragon to come ashore at a different island?
options: Because they are vigorous swimmers and can plunge into the water.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A . Đoạn 4 đã miêu tả: 'Luckily, Komodo dragons are vigorous swimmers. So the surviving female can plunge into the ocean...' (May mắn thay, rồng Komodo là những con vật bơi lội mạnh mẽ. Vì vậy con cái sống sót có thể lao xuống đại dương...). Nhờ khả năng này mà chúng có thể dạt vào bờ (ashore) ở một hòn đảo khác.

questions.content: How can a female komodo dragon prolong the survival of the species in case of a disaster?
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Ở đoạn 4 có nói: '...she can prolong the survival of the species... she can reproduce by herself.' (...nó có thể kéo dài sự sống còn của giống loài... nó có thể tự mình sinh sản). Đây chính là cách duy trì nòi giống của chúng khi gặp thảm họa đó!

questions.content: According to the passage, what happens to the genes of the population overtime?
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A . Câu này có thể tìm thấy trực tiếp trong bài ở đoạn 4: 'Over time, the genes within the population diverge.' (Theo thời gian, các gen trong quần thể bị phân hóa). Cứ chọn A là đúng chuẩn luôn!

questions.content: What will happen to the komodo babies if the genes are homogeneous?
options: The babies will be weaker and have genetic problems.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Đoạn 3 có nêu giả thiết này: 'If the genes are homogeneous, the babies are weaker and have genetic problems.' (Nếu các gen đồng nhất, những đứa con sẽ yếu hơn và có các vấn đề về di truyền). Câu trả lời bê nguyên ý của đoạn này !
